headline: IPCA Laboratories reports a 32.5% jump in Q2 net profit
hook: Strong export growth lifts quarterly profit
summary: IPCA Laboratories posted a net profit of ₹375 crore for the second quarter, marking a 32.5% year-on-year increase driven by strong export growth. Revenue rose 13.8% to ₹2,910 crore, while EBITDA margin improved to 23%. This performance came despite its subsidiary Unichem recognizing a ₹24.26-crore provision for a UK legal claim. Indian retail investors holding pharmaceutical stocks can view this as a sign of resilient export demand and margin expansion for mid-cap drugmakers.
why_it_matters: Stronger export margins boost sentiment for mid-cap pharma stocks
winners_losers: IPCA Labs gains / Unichem hurt by legal provision

headline: Unichem Laboratories files financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
hook: September quarter financial results now on record
summary: Unichem Laboratories Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance data for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can review these figures on the exchange portal to assess the company's earnings, revenue, and overall financial health. These periodic disclosures are essential for tracking the operational progress of listed pharmaceutical companies.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data allows shareholders to assess Unichem's recent financial performance.
